### Headline summary
- Nvidia's board has launched an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following reports of an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/08/technology/nvidias-investigation-jensen-huang.html), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/08/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation))
- OpenAI has raised $11 billion in a new funding round, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion. ([Tech Monitor](https://www.techmonitor.ai/news/openai-secures-11bn-in-funding-round-with-1-25tn-valuation), [Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5zTArBWIArc))
- Anthropic released its new Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models, which are priced at $8 per million input tokens. ([Vercel Blog](https://vercel.com/changelog/claude-fable-5-2-now-available-on-ai-gateway), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1030005/anthropic-claude-fable-mythos-5-2))

### Nvidia board opens investigation into CEO Jensen Huang
Nvidia's board of directors has launched an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following reports of an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, a situation that has raised national security concerns and prompted the company to hire a crisis communications firm. The probe has drawn attention to Huang's family involvement in the company and his public statements regarding the matter, while political fi… ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/08/technology/nvidias-investigation-jensen-huang.html), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/08/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/08/us/politics/rubio-nvidia-ceo-chinese-spy.html), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-09/trump-backs-nvidia-ceo-after-he-admits-affair-video))

### OpenAI secures $11bn in funding round
OpenAI has raised $11 billion in the first part of a new funding round, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion. The company indicated that more funding is expected to come in the future. ([Tech Monitor](https://www.techmonitor.ai/news/openai-secures-11bn-in-funding-round-with-1-25tn-valuation), [Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5zTArBWIArc))

### Anthropic releases Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2 models
Anthropic has released its new Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models, which the company describes as best suited for ambitious, open-ended technical work. The new models are priced at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. ([Vercel Blog](https://vercel.com/changelog/claude-fable-5-2-now-available-on-ai-gateway), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1030005/anthropic-claude-fable-mythos-5-2), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-09/anthropic-unveils-new-fable-mythos-ai-models-ahead-of-ipo), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261109/p38#a261109p38))

### Anthropic secures $3.4B generator deal for AI data centers
Anthropic has secured a $3.4 billion deal to purchase gas turbines for its AI data centers. The agreement is part of the company's efforts to secure power infrastructure for its expanding operations. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/anthropic-secures-34-billion-generator-deal-ai-data-centers-ft-reports-2026-11-08/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/09/anthropic-joins-ais-natural-gas-frenzy-buys-3-4b-worth-of-turbines/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/anthropic-reported-to-buy-gas-turbines-as-ai-power-access-tightens/))

### OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber for security
OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, an AI model designed to help security researchers hunt for software vulnerabilities, which has already identified numerous bugs in Firefox and Linux. ([Tech Monitor](https://www.techmonitor.ai/news/openai-launches-gpt-6-cyber-to-find-software-vulnerabilities), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/openai-just-released-gpt-6-cyber-ai-can-now-hunt-for-security-vulnerabilities-e3d91d2745fa?source=rss----98111c9905da---4))

### Google releases Gemini 4 Argon for robotics
Google released Gemini 4 Argon, a general-purpose physical-reasoning model intended for robotics control, simulation, and policy improvement. ([News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-ai-agents-robot-code-virtual.html), [InfoQ](https://www.infoq.com/news/2026/11/google-gemini-argon/?utm_campaign=infoq_content&utm_source=infoq&utm_medium=feed&utm_term=AI%2C+ML+%26+Data+Engineering))

### Meta releases Muse Ember lightweight AI model
Meta introduced Muse Ember, a lightweight and cost-efficient multimodal model designed for agent execution and coding tasks, which is now available on Vercel's AI Gateway. ([Vercel Blog](https://vercel.com/changelog/muse-ember-now-available-on-ai-gateway), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/09/meta-releases-muse-ember-a-new-lightweight-model-for-agent-execution/), [The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/meta-muse-ember-launch/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261109/p35#a261109p35))

### Disney and Adobe announce generative AI alliance
Disney and Adobe have announced a strategic alliance to integrate Adobe's Firefly generative AI technology into Disney's entertainment ecosystem. The partnership aims to create brand-safe AI models and embed Adobe's CX Enterprise Coworker within leading AI platforms to support Disney's content creation and streaming priorities. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/adobes-cx-enterprise-coworker-gets-embedded-within-leading-ai-platforms), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261109/p29#a261109p29), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/disney-bets-on-adobes-firefly-to-create-brand-safe-ai-models-for-its-entertainment-empire/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/disney-and-adobe-announce-ai-alliance-with-custom-firefly-models/))
